definitions.explanation: An increase to twice the original amount, or more broadly, a dramatic increase in quantity or intensity.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}が{倍増|ばいぞう}した。
{予算|よさん}を{倍増|ばいぞう}させる{計画|けいかく}がある。
examples.english: There is a plan to double the budget.

examples.japanese: {防衛費|ぼうえいひ}の{倍増|ばいぞう}をめぐって{国会|こっかい}で{議論|ぎろん}が{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: Debate continues in the Diet over doubling the defense budget.

notes:
Often used in business, economic, and political contexts. Both the intransitive ({倍増|ばいぞう}する) and the transitive/causative ({倍増|ばいぞう}させる) forms are common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{売上|うりあげ}が{倍増|ばいぞう}する (sales double)
・{予算|よさん}を{倍増|ばいぞう}させる (double the budget)
・{生産量|せいさんりょう}の{倍増|ばいぞう} (doubling of production)
・{所得|しょとく}{倍増|ばいぞう}{計画|けいかく} (income doubling plan)
